name: video-text
title: Video Text
description: Big bold letters used as a window onto moving imagery: here a drifting ocean-coloured gradient with soft moving light, visible only inside the letters.
useWhen: A big one-word title should carry moving colour or footage inside its letters.
A title card needs a texture that hints at the topic (water, fire, city lights).
avoidWhen: The text is small or long: the footage inside will not read.
A static colour fill is enough.
author: Magic UI

variables.label: Text
variables.description: The word the footage shows through. Short, in capitals reads best.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer text shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Colour A
variables.description: Deep colour of the default fill.

variables.label: Colour B
variables.description: Mid colour of the default fill.

variables.label: Colour C
variables.description: Highlight colour of the default fill.

variables.label: Drift speed
variables.description: How fast the default fill drifts.
